summary: An open-source, self-hosted platform for email marketing, mail server management, and newsletter distribution, built with Go and free from recurring fees.
usecases: Self-hosting a custom email marketing platform without monthly subscription costs.
Managing transactional emails and SMTP services for web applications.
Running a private newsletter service with built-in subscriber management.
ideas: Combining with AI to auto-generate email content for marketing campaigns.
Deploying as a white-label email infrastructure for agencies serving multiple clients.
Integrating with analytics tools to track open rates and engagement via custom APIs.
